notes.title: V1.1.2 update announcement
notes.content:
First of all, thanks for your support. The updated contents of this version are as follows:
1. The release condition of the legend anchor's plot has been changed from money to "intimacy" with the legend anchor.
2. At the end of each plot dialogue, a gift giving session is added to increase the intimacy with the current legendary anchor.
3. Only when you choose the right gift can you get more intimacy.
4. Optimize the UI and increase the display of intimacy attributes on the interface.
5. If you have already unlocked the plot and video before, you can watch it without any gift giving.

We promise that the game will continue to introduce new free characters and optimize the game content.
